2026_01_MIA_LV.headline: Miami’s young offense tries to exploit a Raiders attack missing its best mismatch weapon
2026_01_MIA_LV.paragraph1: Miami is leaning on a young receiving group around Malik Willis, while Las Vegas will be without Brock Bowers after his knee procedure. That changes the Raiders’ middle-of-field threat and puts more weight on Ashton Jeanty and the run game to keep the offense on schedule. Miami’s challenge is protecting Willis and creating easy throws for inexperienced targets; Las Vegas must replace Bowers’ coverage gravity without becoming one-dimensional, especially if the Dolphins can force longer third downs.
2026_01_MIA_LV.model_rationale: Las Vegas loses a major coverage stressor without Bowers, while Miami’s ability to stay balanced and protect Willis will determine whether the Raiders can dictate the game with pressure.
